WITH target_employees AS (
    SELECT edh.businessentityid, d.name AS department
    FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh
    JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
    WHERE d.name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
)
SELECT 
    te.department,
    p.lastname,
    eph.rate,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY te.department ORDER BY eph.rate) AS cume_dist,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY te.department ORDER BY eph.rate) AS percent_rank
FROM target_employees te
JOIN humanresources.employeepayhistory eph ON te.businessentityid = eph.businessentityid
JOIN person.person p ON te.businessentityid = p.businessentityid
ORDER BY te.department ASC, eph.rate DESC
